about: Hole-by-hole plan for a ~95 round. aim_m shifts tee shots and layups sideways from the middle of the fairway (negative = left, positive = right, in the direction of play); green_aim_m does the same for the approach. Clubs are not written here: the app picks them from the bag, the map and the hazards, so they stay right when the bag changes.

notes: Dogleg left with OB along the whole left side: start the ball at the right half of the fairway.
A waste bunker fills the fairway neck at the dogleg. Play right of it, not a hero cut over the corner.
Green is shallow (21 m deep) and bunkered both sides: take one more club rather than come up short, and favor the middle of the green over the flag.
Long, straight par 5: three solid shots, no hero second.
Lay up to a full-swing number, not an awkward half wedge.
Short par 4: the tee shot only has to stay short of the bunkers that pinch the fairway.
Green slopes away at the back: short of the flag beats long.
Tee is off to the right: aim at the middle of the corner, where the fairway is widest.
Small green squeezed by two bunkers: middle of the green, short is fine.
Narrow par 3 with OB right: if in doubt, miss left.
Green is bunkered front-left, front-right and back: take the middle of the green, not the flag.
One of the hardest holes: OB runs close all down the right, favour the left half.
The second shot plays downhill, so the ball flies a little further.
Bogey is a good score here.

holes.key_hazard: OB along the right of the dogleg
notes: Dogleg right with OB hugging the whole bend: aim down the left.
Green is well guarded at the front: lay up to a full-swing number instead of chasing it.
Long par 3 with OB right and a bunker catching everything left.
Short of the green is the safe miss: a chip and two putts is a bogey, OB is a double.
Hardest hole on the card: water from the landing zone all the way to the green on the left.
Aim at the right side of the fairway and the right half of the green (shared with 18).
Bogey is a good score.

holes.key_hazard: OB right off the tee, lakes behind and right of the green
notes: Downhill par 4 with OB right off the tee: favour the left.
Water behind and to the right of the green: aim front-left and never go long.
Long par 3 over water on the right: favor the left-center, not the far left - two bunkers guard that side too.
Laying up short and chipping on is a perfectly good plan.
OB runs down the whole right side: the tee shot is the key, keep it left-center.
Lay up to a full-swing number and attack from there.
OB is on the right, so miss left if in doubt - but there's now a bunker front-left too, so aim center-left rather than the far edge.
Tricky green: two putts is a good result.

holes.key_hazard: OB and bushes right, bunkers at the green entrance
notes: Hardest hole on the back nine: OB and bushes on the right, aim left-center.
Two bunkers guard the front of the green: if you can't carry them comfortably, lay up and pitch on.
Bogey is a good score.

holes.key_hazard: Bunkers either side of the green
notes: Shortest par 4: a birdie chance only if you play it simply.
Set up a full-swing approach rather than a long tee shot that leaves an awkward half wedge.
Small, well-protected green: aim front-middle.
Short of the green and a chip is fine. Long or in a bunker costs more.

holes.key_hazard: Water left in the driving zone
notes: Water on the left where the tee shot lands, with bunkers just past it on the right: aim center, not at either edge.
Three-shot hole for everyone: lay up to a comfortable full-swing number.

holes.key_hazard: Water right and in front of the green
notes: Water down the right and in front of the green: aim left all the way.
Aim at the middle of the green and forget the flag. Bunkers back-left and right of the flag both leave a downhill lie.
